entries: {DISASTER:strikes} came to {place}, and afterwards the knocking started
{MESSAGE:physical} arrived from {SOMEONE:!plural}, dead since spring: come to {landmark}
the {rival} sealed {landmark} {MANNER}, and something inside began to scratch
{SOMEONE:!plural} walked into {place} {MANNER} with no shadow at all
{first} heard {CLOSE:human} laughing in an empty room at {landmark}
a light came on at {landmark}, empty since {DISASTER:strikes}
{first} woke {MANNER} holding {THING:portable}, with mud on the floor
{DISASTER:strikes} cut {place} off, and every phone rang empty
the {rival} dared {first} {MANNER} to spend the night at {landmark}
